By week 6, email marketing automation flows (uc_006) will start to deliver returns of £36-42 per £1 spent. By week 10, the size guide chatbot (uc_005) will reduce size-related returns by up to 25%, and the WhatsApp styling assistant (uc_007) will help close sales. By week 12, AI demand forecasting (uc_008) and dynamic pricing engine (uc_010) will reduce forecasting errors and improve gross margins.
